messages:
tess: FYI starting a brief 45m quiet window on the release train due to a rolled increase in 5xx on canary after the model-slim rollout. Holding new merges to prod-targeted branches.
omar: soft freeze acknowledged. Are rollbacks already automated?
tess: yes — rollback policy in effect. If error_rate > 1% sustained for 4m rollback will trigger. Hotfixes ok with release-ops signoff.
randhir: telemetry shows spike around 2026-04-02T14:02Z tied to model-slim v1.2.4. P95 token latency jumped from 320ms -> 1.2s.
tess: thanks. For mitigation: 1) reduce canary traffic to 10%, 2) cap batch_size=8 on /v1/generate, 3) enable model-fallback map for non-critical routes.
release-bot: Deploy controller: canary pipeline paused for model-slim:v1.2.4 on shard-D. Auto-rollback armed: threshold=1% error_rate over 4m.
infra-bot: note: autoscaler min_replicas bumped to 3 for shard-D during the window. Also increasing JVM heap headroom on runtime pods as short-term mitigation.
omar: collecting heap dump and thread dump from pod shard-d-runtime-5. Will attach link in 10m.
randhir: experimenting with disabling KV-prefetch on a targeted canary instance to see impact on p95. If it helps we'll patch rollout config.
tess: perfect — post results. If KV-prefetch=false stabilizes, we'll resume slow ramp to 25% then normal cadence. If not, extend quiet window.
release-bot: Incident-tracker: ticket IR-2026-201 opened and linked. Use exceptions form https://internal/release-ops/exceptions for overrides.
infra-bot: sample command for ops to check pods: `kubectl get pods -n canary -l shard=D -o wide` and `kubectl logs -f pod/shard-d-runtime-5 -c runtime`.
omar: posted heap link: https://internal/storage/heap/shard-d/heap-2026-04-02.hprof — running pprof now.
tess: summary: 45m soft quiet-window, canary ->10%, batch_size=8 cap, fallback map active, hotfixes via signoff only. I'll update when we lift or extend. :loudspeaker:
